title: Who Stays for Winter?

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Look: the first snow! The swallows that nested under the eaves have flown away south, where it's warm.

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: But some creatures stay with us all winter. Let's sort them, and find out who will need our help.

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Put the creatures that fly away south in the sky, and the ones that stay here in the snowy meadow.
steps.hint: The swallows fly south. The robins and ducks stay with us.

older.prompt: Sort the creatures: some fly away south, some stay awake all winter, and some sleep until spring.
older.hint: Swallows fly south. Robins, ducks and rabbits stay awake. Bees, ladybirds and butterflies rest until spring.

feedback.mismatch: Hmm, does that one stay, or go? Think about where it spends the winter.
feedback.all_good: You know who stays! The robins and ducks will need seeds and water all winter.

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: God made each creature to know what to do when winter comes. Isn't that a wonder?

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: The robins will be glad of the bird feeders now. Shall we keep them full?

journal_line: I learned which creatures fly south and which stay for the winter.
